text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, that tree's glowing! And so is the
inside of the pool! This is so,
so cool! It's
like a world of magic!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! This place looks completely
different at nighttime! We
should invite
Taishin and the others next time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! Apparently, they only light up
the area like this at
night! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, are you sure you want to stay?
You're not forcing yourself to
be here, are
you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm not. I thought about it
and decided I should stay.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd forgotten, actually, but my mom sent
me a swimsuit. She told me to
go out and
have fun once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...She seemed to think I needed it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I had no idea. So her mom said the same
thing...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we wouldn't want to upset
your mom! Let's make sure you
have some
fun! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gah! What is this sparkly ball?! Why is it
shining?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! Let's play a game! Whoever
manages to keep the ball
until the very
end wins!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea. That might be a good
training exerci—oh, forget
training! I'm not
losing to any of you if we're doing this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best too! ...Huh? Where are all
these bubbles coming from?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We ran into quite a few
roadblocks... but I'm glad everyone is

having fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll join in too! Woooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Is this really safe? Are we sure this is safe? Is it actually okay for three people to be on this thing?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's a three-seater! Come on,
keep your eyes open and
go, go, gooo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah-ah-aaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, oh my gosh... No, no, nooo!
This is way too faaast!

text_block_list.name: Spe and Scarlet
text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Ahaha! That was so scary! But it
was fun too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was so scared, I thought I was a
goner. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling laughter echoes across the night
pool. Then, at the end of
the night...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... All I did was play, but I'm
exhausted. I still can't get over how
pretty
the pool looked, all lit up and glittery...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I agree! They didn't have anything like
that before. I suppose even
Bubblyland
isn't immune to change.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
How was today, Scarlet? Did you have
fun?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I did. It's stressful to think about how I
haven't done any training,
but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I suppose... it's not so bad to let loose
once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we have just a little bit more
fun tomorrow before we go
home, then?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when the next day rolls around...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! ♪ It's all about the disco when
you come to Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um, is it really okay for us to be up here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course! Dance floors are made to be danced on! Come on, get into the groove! There's no half-hearted dancing allowed here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Apparently, the most
important thing at a disco is to let
go of all
your worries and dance your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You say that as if it's easy to do either of
those things...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...No, I can't be like this. I'm here now, so
I'm going to do it right or
it's a waste of
time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to dance with everything I've
got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-me too!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hang on! Isn't that Special Week and
Daiwa Scarlet next to
Maruzensky?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Here I go... W-wooooo! Let's dance,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I can do this too... Um... T-turn up that
music, DJ!

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Great job, you two!
